query.historical_contract: [Site](https://www.africanstorybook.org/); curated language/level collections or agreed export.
query.authentication: Anonymous public approved catalog; no new account/key/payment.

licensing: Current African Storybook homepage advertises open picture books and CC BY4.0/Saide attribution. Item/contributor permissions and exact translated editions remain separate from this metadata search verification.
limitations: The language selector is a custom popup; native selectOption timed out because the underlying select is hidden. This working batch uses the visible All languages default. English-filter behavior remains unverified. Broad cat search matched summaries/substrings and had no literal English-title match in first40; retain that negative and use the more specific cats query.
Fixed a menu-readiness race before querying; both browser initialization failures retained. No CAPTCHA, login, hidden control or private API bypass.

Some catalog cards are multilingual and use true in the native action plus multiple language IDs. Parser corrected to retain these instead of rejecting the whole response; selected positives are monolingual English. Repeated native IDs with mono/bilingual reader configurations are grouped with variants, not counted as separate books.
Some non-Latin catalog text renders with mojibake in the upstream UI; multilingual display quality remains unresolved. This is not silently corrected or counted as a verified translation.
Native numeric book IDs, reader-action arguments and raw date attributes are kept. Date meaning/version identity and actual full-reader access remain unverified; no books/audio downloaded.
next_action: Keep research query evidence current; expand supported search boundaries and item access review. No production activation in this task.
